summary: A progress report from Rand on checking which ARPANET sites had been tested against the early protocols. The table notes whether each host handled the host-host protocol basics, the initial connection protocol, and Telnet as user and server. It warns that these were one-time arranged tests, not a measure of ongoing availability.

eli5.summary: A report card showing which computers passed a few simple tests so far. The teacher warns that passing one test does not mean the computer is always working.
